meta.title: Material 3 theme
meta.description: Material You colours, surface tones instead of borders and state layers instead of shadows.

page.title: Material 3 theme
page.description: Material You colour roles, surface tones instead of borders, and state layers instead of shadows. Light and dark are generated together, so the two palettes always agree.
page.enabledDescription: Recolours surfaces, labels, borders and state colours with Material 3 roles. Turn it off to return to the theme you had before.
page.systemDescription: Derived from your Windows accent colour.
page.systemUnavailable: No accent colour is set on this system, so the Material baseline palette is used.
page.sourcePresetDescription: One of the eight Material 3 seed colours.
page.sourceCustomDescription: Pick any colour; light and dark palettes are generated from it.
page.customUnavailable: The custom palette could not be generated. The previous palette is still in use.
page.customStaleHost: The running Host is an older version and ignored the seed. Restart dsh, then pick the colour again.
page.note: Changes apply immediately and are remembered in this browser, so they survive a reload without restarting the harness.
